name: Nanping municipal and operator data centers
developer: Nanping municipal government; China Mobile; China Telecom
notes: Fujian Data Management Bureau item says Nanping had a municipal government data-center room of about 900 sq m with 142 standard cabinets, plus two social/commercial data centers: a China Mobile facility of about 8,000 sq m with 300 standard cabinets and a China Telecom facility of about 2,000 sq m with 67 standard cabinets.

name: Nanping Artificial Intelligence Application Pilot Base
developer: Nanping municipal information/state-owned platform
notes: Official Fujian Data Management Bureau article says Nanping is planning an AI application pilot base in Wuyi New Area with total investment of RMB 540 million, intended to integrate computing power, algorithms, data and application incubation.

name: Ningde Big Data Industrial Park and supporting infrastructure project
developer: Ningde municipal/project investment promotion authorities
notes: Fujian Investment Promotion page describes a 200-mu Ningde big data industrial park. Phase 1 planned one data-center building, one R&D support building and 1,000 cabinets, with long-term planning for 10,000 cabinets.

name: Ningde Telecom-CATL same-city dual-active data center project
developer: China Telecom Ningde; CATL
notes: People's Daily Fujian reported Ningde Telecom and CATL signed to build Fujian's first industrial-enterprise same-city dual-active data center project, meaning two data centers deployed in the same city for high availability.

name: Douxun Cloud Computing / Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Fujian Douxun Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Provincial government reported the RMB 3 billion Douxun cloud-computing data-center project as a major Putian project with 5,000 cabinets and 100,000 servers planned. CCTV/local coverage in 2024 placed the project in Licheng District, said construction began in November 2022, and described phase 1 as about 95,000 sq m with nearly 6,000 standard racks and about 20,000P compute.

name: Digital Fujian (Anxi) Industrial Park Big Data Center
developer: Digital Fujian (Anxi) Industrial Park; Guofurui/China International Electronic Commerce Center ecosystem
notes: Official Fujian/Quanzhou sources describe a T4-grade big data center in Digital Fujian (Anxi) Industrial Park, planned for 20,000 standard cabinets, 8,000 cabinets put into production, and 4,600 cabinets already in use or deployed by 2022-2023.

name: Shishi Tencent Cloud intelligent computing project
developer: Tencent Cloud / Shishi local partners
notes: Fujian Investment Promotion article on Quanzhou AI infrastructure says future projects include a Shishi Tencent Cloud 4,000P project and a 300P cross-strait data-element ecosystem industrial park project.

name: Digital Fujian (Anxi) Industrial Park Data Center Phase II
developer: Digital Fujian (Anxi) Industrial Park; telecom operators; Sugon ecosystem
notes: Quanzhou Evening News/Dongnan Net reported Quanzhou was accelerating Digital Fujian (Anxi) Industrial Park data center phase II, with more than 4,600 cabinets already built and put into operation and operators including China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom and Sugon expanding data centers.

name: China Mobile Fujian Sanming Big Data Center
developer: China Mobile Communications Group Fujian Co., Ltd.
notes: Sanming municipal government reported China Mobile Fujian's big-data-center construction project landed in Sanming High-tech Zone Jinsha Park. The RMB 230 million project covers 3,570 sq m, total building area 9,500 sq m, and plans to purchase 1,000 standardized data-center racks to serve Sanming, Longyan and Nanping.

name: Sangang Minguang intelligent control center and cloud computing center
developer: Sangang Minguang / Sanming digital economy signing parties
notes: Fujian Development and Reform Commission reported a Sanming digital-economy signing package including the RMB 430 million Sangang Minguang intelligent control center and cloud-computing center construction project.

name: China Mobile (Fujian Xiamen) Data Center
developer: China Mobile Fujian
notes: Dongnan Net/Fujian Daily and Invest Xiamen reported completion of the China Mobile Fujian Xiamen data center in Tongxiang High-tech City. The RMB 1.2 billion project covers 66,000 sq m and can install 8,000 communications cabinets with 2.8T export bandwidth.

name: China Mobile (Fujian Xiamen) provincial cloud resource pool
developer: China Mobile Cloud / China Mobile Fujian
notes: The same completion report states China Mobile's only provincial public-cloud node resource pool in Fujian, Mobile Cloud provincial node resource pool (Fujian) phase 1, was placed at the Xiamen data center.

name: Zhangzhou Big Data Center at Yutang Digital Economy Industrial Park
developer: Zhangzhou municipal authorities / Yutang Digital Economy Industrial Park
notes: Dongnan Net reported the launch ceremony for Zhangzhou Big Data Center phase 1A in Yutang Digital Economy Industrial Park. The city key project has planned investment of RMB 1 billion, about 40,000 sq m of floor area, three data-room buildings plus power support building, and capacity for about 5,000 cabinets.

name: Huawei Zhangzhou cloud computing data center green retrofit / operations
developer: Huawei / Zhangzhou Development Zone
notes: Zhangzhou municipal three-year new-infrastructure action plan calls for accelerating the Zhangzhou Big Data Center and guiding green transformation of the Huawei Zhangzhou cloud computing data center in Zhangzhou Development Zone, indicating an existing cloud data-center asset.

name: Baiyin District Artificial Intelligence Open Platform / Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Baiyin District Big Data Center; China Mobile Gansu Baiyin; SenseTime
notes: Baiyin District government公告 for stages 2-3 says the project is led by Baiyin District Big Data Center, jointly won by China Mobile Gansu Baiyin and SenseTime, at RMB 49.96864 million, located at 262 Jianshe East Road, and includes an AI open platform, algorithm warehouse, big data platform, general data services, scenario applications, intelligent computing center and streaming servers. A 2024 procurement notice records a stage-1 expansion.

name: Baiyin Zitian Hongke Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Baiyin Zitian Hongke Intelligent Computing Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Jingyuan County project filing lists a new internet data service / intelligent computing center at Baiyin Liuchuan Industrial Concentration Area, with 128 equipment sets, 140 cabinets at 12 kW each, 2,000P FP16 AI servers and supporting network, security, storage and AI software systems. MW is calculated from 140 x 12 kW cabinet capacity.

name: Baiyin Digital Economy Industrial Park
developer: Baiyin Technology Business Incubator Co., Ltd.; Longyuan Big Data Service (Gansu) Co., Ltd.
notes: Xinhua Gansu reported Baiyin Technology Business Incubator and Longyuan Big Data Service (Gansu) signed a cooperation agreement for the Baiyin Digital Economy Industrial Park project. Source confirms a digital-economy park agreement but does not state data-center capacity.

name: Dingxi United Big Data Center
developer: Dingxi municipal government / Dingxi Big Data Center
notes: Dingxi municipal government reported the launch/unveiling of Dingxi Big Data Center. The United Big Data Center project consists mainly of a city operations management/emergency command center, city-brain intelligent middle platform and command-city cloud service platform, integrating public-security, emergency, traffic, environmental and government-service data.

name: Dingxi digital base improvement and digital employee application project phase 1
developer: Dingxi Anwei Big Data Co., Ltd.
notes: Dingxi public resources exchange tender for a RMB 22 million phase-1 digital-base project includes data governance, data-fusion systems, city operations IOC modules, AI algorithm warehouse, low-altitude dispatch platform, domestic high-performance computing servers and full-chain security equipment.

name: Huashengyun Hezuo City Data Center
developer: Huashengyun / Hezuo City project parties
notes: Seetao reported the Huashengyun Hezuo City data center in Gannan started construction with total investment of RMB 2 billion across three phases. The plan called for completion by September 2025, 550 racks in total, including 400 computing racks and 150 storage racks, 500 PB storage and 11.2 exaFLOPS-class advertised floating-point service.

name: Gannan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture Big Data Service Center
developer: Gannan prefectural government; China Mobile Gansu cooperation
notes: National Ethnic Affairs Commission reported the Gannan Big Data Service Center unveiling and a 5G+ big-data service application innovation cooperation framework. A later Gansu government item says Gansu Mobile signed a Digital Gannan strategic cooperation framework around 5G, industrial internet, big data, cloud computing, AI and IoT.

name: Xinhai Cheng Big Data Center (Jiayuguan)
developer: Xinhai Cheng project company / Jiayuguan municipal investment attraction
notes: 2019 signed key investment project; planned total investment 2.86bn CNY, standardized machine rooms, ~100k servers; follow-up construction status unverified.

name: Jiayuguan AI Computing Center Industrial Park source-network-load-storage integration project
developer: Jiayuguan municipal investment attraction / project owner entity
notes: Key municipal investment project; owner still completing filing/approval procedures; officially not yet具备开工条件 as of mid-2026.

name: Zijin Cloud Big Data Center
developer: Gansu Zijin Cloud Big Data Development / Gansu Energy Investment; China Telecom partnership for Tianyi Cloud facility
notes: Green Data Center recognition article says the project is a Gansu 13th Five-Year key information project, planned in three phases with about CNY5.0bn investment; phase 1 first stage had 2,543 rentable racks and a telecom business license. DCD/IDCNova reported a China Telecom Tianyi Cloud Big Data Center inaugurated at the Zijin Cloud site with 203 initial racks and 260 servers.

name: Gansu Jiuquan Cloud Computing Big Data Center
developer: Jiuquan municipal project; tenants include Inspur Group, Shanghai Newtouch, Tianhe Cloud
notes: Opened April 28, 2021. Reported as a 100-mu, CNY3.0bn, three-phase cloud-computing/big-data center with 10,000 planned racks; phase 1 completed with 18,300 sqm and 2,200 standard racks in operation.

name: China Mobile (Gansu Lanzhou) Data Center Phase II / Lanzhou New Area Data Center
developer: China Mobile Group Gansu Co., Ltd.; contractor China Construction Third Engineering Bureau
notes: CSCEC reported phase II passed completion acceptance in Lanzhou New Area, adding one data-center building and one power center across about 26,000 sqm with about 7,000-rack installed capacity; Uptime lists the China Mobile Gansu Lanzhou New Area Data Center Phase 1 floor.

name: Lanzhou New Area Big Data Industrial Park IDC facilities
developer: Lanzhou New Area Science, Culture and Tourism Group with China Mobile, ZTE, Huawei, Sugon and other partners
notes: China Belt and Road portal reported Lanzhou New Area had landed China Mobile, China Telecom, State Grid cloud data centers plus Huawei and Sugon projects; 1# IDC, smart-city operations center, power building and R&D building were operating, with phase II under construction and about 15,200 racks available after completion.

name: Chaoxun Communication x Lanzhou New Area Big Data Industrial Park strategic cooperation
developer: Chaoxun Communication (A-share 603322) / Lanzhou New Area Sci-Culture-Tourism Group
notes: Listed-company announcement (Jul 9): strategic cooperation positioning for East-Data-West-Computing node at Lanzhou New Area Big Data Industrial Park; capacity figures not disclosed.

name: Linxia Prefecture Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Linxia Prefecture, China Mobile Gansu, CHN Energy Gansu Power, Beijing Zhongshu Botong Technology
notes: Framework agreement signed September 13, 2024. Planned investment CNY1.5bn, including AI compute, storage, network and operations platforms; total planned computing capacity 3,000 PFLOPS.

name: Wujiu Expressway modular data centers
developer: Gansu Changda Road Industry / Gansu Provincial Highway Aviation Tourism Investment Group; Huawei Digital Power solution
notes: Huawei case study describes a distributed transport-infrastructure data center deployment for the Wujiu Expressway in Longnan: 11 toll/service/tunnel sites use FusionModule800 micro-modular data centers, with the monitoring sub-center using FusionModule2000, deployed within one month. Small edge/special-purpose facility rather than public colocation.

name: Gansu Qingyang National Data Center Cluster / East-Data-West-Computing Industrial Park
developer: Qingyang East Data West Computing Industrial Park / Qingyang Yunchuang Smart Big Data Co., Ltd.; multiple telecom and AI tenants
notes: NDRC identified Gansu/Ningxia as a national computing hub. AIIB lists a proposed USD410m green/low-carbon infrastructure project supporting expansion of Qingyang Computing Industrial Park. People's Daily reported 6 intelligent-computing centers operational, 10+ under construction, 31,000 racks operating and more than 51,000 PFLOPS. National Data Administration/CCTV later reported about 22 data-center buildings planned to start in 2026 and a target above 200,000 PFLOPS by year-end.

name: China Mobile (Gansu Qingyang) Data Center N01 / New Industrialization Green Intelligent Computing Center
developer: China Mobile Group Gansu Co., Ltd.
notes: People's Daily identified the China Mobile new industrialization green intelligent computing center inside Qingyang EDWC park as operational. Science and Technology Daily described China Mobile (Gansu Qingyang) Data Center N01 as Gansu's first 18 kW intelligent-computing high-power data center and part of a domestic 10,000-card compute cluster.

name: China Telecom Gansu Qingyang Intelligent Computing Center
developer: China Telecom Gansu
notes: Gansu press reported China Telecom Gansu Qingyang Intelligent Computing Center started construction in 2024 as part of the Qingyang cluster. People's Daily later described the China Telecom Qingyang computing center's Xirang scheduling platform operating with more than 30,000 PFLOPS visible in the dispatch platform.

name: Northwest Zero-Carbon Smart Cloud Intelligent Computing Center Phase I
developer: Supercomputing Digital Technology (Gansu) Co., Ltd.
notes: Phase I started construction February 28, 2026 in Qingyang East-Data-West-Computing Industrial Park. Reported investment CNY2.585bn, site area 58.33 mu, nearly 90,000 sqm, two machine-room buildings plus power building, 6,600 high-density racks and planned compute above 30,000-35,000 PFLOPS with PUE <=1.198.

name: China Energy Engineering Qingyang Big Data Industrial Park (A1/A2 DC buildings)
developer: China Energy Engineering Group (CEEC)
notes: A1 DC building operational since Sep 2024; A2 building designed to carry ~40,000P compute; described as largest-in-construction Qingyang cluster big-data project.

name: Zero-Carbon Smart Qingyang Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Qingyang cluster project company (unnamed in source)
notes: Construction started Mar 2026; planned 7,400+ GPU servers, intelligent-compute scale >35,000P.

name: Kingsoft Cloud Belt & Road (Qingyang Cluster) Computing Center
developer: Kingsoft Cloud
notes: Listed in Qingyang major-project list (2026) alongside China Telecom Qingyang intelligent-computing center phase and Unicom Qingyang DC phase I; scale unverified.

name: Gansu Mobile Second Big Data Center
developer: China Mobile Gansu / Tianshui branch
notes: C114/People's Posts and Telecommunications News reported a groundbreaking in Tianshui Chengji New City: CNY350m investment, 20-mu site and 1,000 racks. Later Tianshui government/technology-bureau snippets describe the Gansu Mobile Second Big Data Center as built; operational status inferred from those later public government references.

name: Daosheng Cloud (Wuwei) Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Daosheng Cloud (Wuwei) Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: T1 building lit up on December 31, 2024; Gansu Daily reported the Hexi area's first large-scale AI computing facility entered operation. Site is 172 mu, about CNY5.0bn investment, about 140,000 sqm gross floor area, 4 high-performance computing buildings, 25,000 PFLOPS total planned floating-point compute, with initial 1,000 PFLOPS domestic inference compute and 5,000 PFLOPS capacity in T1.
